about: The terminal is in the Khomutovo planning district on the southern outskirts of Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, 10 km from the centre. The terminal complex is operated by JSC Aerovokzal Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk; the complex covers more than 47,000 sq. m.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Buses No. 3, 8 and 63 run from the centre; the terminal is their last stop. They run from 6:30 to 22:00, journey time 30–40 min. Suburban train from the railway station to Khomutovo, then about 10 min by bus. Taxi: about 25 min, about 350 ₽.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Short-stay P2: the first 15 min are free; over 15 min up to and including 60 min costs 400 ₽; longer stays cost 1,200 ₽ for the first day and 600 ₽ per subsequent day. Long-stay P3: 500 ₽ per day for days 1–5, then 400 ₽. Re-entry within 30 min after leaving has no free period. Free parking for passengers with disabilities requires proof of disability and a Disabled sign on the vehicle.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Aniva business lounge on Level 3, from 6:00 to 23:00: 4,400 ₽, children 2–12 years 2,200 ₽, no more than 2 hours, admits via Every Lounge. Krilyon lounge on Level 2, from 6:00 to 23:00: 2,800 ₽, accepts Comfort pass, Every Lounge, Mir Pass, Grey Wall Pass, ONPASS. Children under 2 free.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage on Level 1 of the terminal. Charges are per calendar day ending at midnight; a partial day counts as a full day. Baggage with combined length, width and height up to 203 cm: 500 ₽ for the first day and 200 ₽ per subsequent day. Over 203 cm: 850 ₽ for the first day and 400 ₽ per subsequent day. Once collected, baggage must be checked in again for further storage.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room on Level 2 in the landside area, from 6:00 to 23:00, free. Admits children under 8 with an adult, children with disabilities under 14, and women in the second half of pregnancy. A ticket or boarding pass, a passport and a birth certificate are required. There is a kitchen with a microwave; no steriliser.
